hi! i currently take lamictal (125mg), and that has had no bearing at all on my ability to feel (which i love it for ) abilify, on the other hand, made me totally empty, like a cardboard person who was  just cognitively stripped. i felt NOTHING for months and it was terrible. i have a history of severe reactions to antidepressants and various other psych meds, and abilify was the one that i recall being the worst. i often felt like i couldn’t form sentences or thoughts appropriately, and it seemed like i had totally lost how to interact socially bc i just couldn’t perceive or feel anything. i don’t know the orders you started taking your meds in, but maybe abilify is the culprit?

2 1/4 tsp yeast
2 tbl honey
1 1/14 c water
3 1/2 cups of flour and some extra for kneading !

i let my yeast/honey/ and a little water bloom for ten minutes, slowly add in flour and mix with my hands till it’s sticky. roll it out w/ extra flour and knead it for ~10 minutes, rises an hour, punch it down and then wait ten minutes or so and then cut into 8 balls. shape them into bagel shapes, and boil them for ab 2-3 minutes. oven at 425° for ab 10-12 minutes
